themes.name: подписка-ловушка и потеря бесплатного доступа
themes.nameEn: paywall trap and loss of free access

reviews.text: Updates?. No updates or new stories in over a year? Why?

Best sleep app. I love to sleep to this and I love that it doesn’t just cut off and wake me up. I get to sleep to rain all night. So luxurious. I learned of doze through my oura app and I am just blown away by all the options of voices and stories. Yall are amazing and I wish yall to continue to grow your app because you’re doing wonderful things for people.

MMHHKEN DECENT DER BUD. Not a bad way to fall asleep, the story’s aren’t too bad, extremely descriptive helping you draw a clear picture of the tale.. sort of having someone reading you a few chapters of a book, as some do for their children before bedtime..

No family sharing. My wife likes this app and has a paid subscription. I would like it too, but don’t want to pay 2x for it. Other sleep apps offer family sharing. This one does not. That is why I gave it such a low rating.

Updated: added family sharing. Now I can give it 5 stars!

Music stops playing halfway into meditation. The music will stop playing a little ways into the beginning of the soundtrack. The meditation will continue without any problems but i have to completely restart the soundtrack and it happens on all of the music. So frustrating when it never used to do this in the past? It’s like they don’t update their product anymore like Piff or whatever the other app is called.
So calm. It’s so cool with so many sounds and stories it has and I hope it has new tings coming

Peaceful. One of my favorite apps. I love the soothing tone of the narrators and the stories are very interesting! I will say I have had to go back and listen again at times when as I find myself drifting off to sleep, which is the point of this app for me. Will gladly continue to pay annually! Great job!
Totally worth it!!. I use this every single day, not only to fall asleep but also as my morning meditation before I even get out of bed. Definitely worth it!

used for months stopped working. Idk what happened but i opened the app and it’s asking me to subscribe again. restore purchase says i don’t have an active subscription but i checked under my apple account and i do. i have severe anxiety and have relied on this app for over a year now. all of a sudden i don’t have my main coping skill.

Was amazed. This app was great, I thought I was on a free segment because th quality was so and so but it worked for the most part and used it on and off without subscribing, but turns out it was a week free only. It now wants a subscription and I don’t think it’s worth it for those whom use it like I do, once or twice a month. The quality wasn’t as good as some of the others which is why it fooled me to believe I was on the free version when I first downloaded.
This app is amazing!. There’s so many free stories to help you drift off and Abby has such a soothing voice! If you have trouble sleeping, please give this a try!
You have to pay to try?. I’d love to try this app but unfortunately there doesn’t seem to be a way past the subscription screen without paying...

Great but the change!?!. I love this app but I’ve only had it for a week and all a sudden I have to pay!?😡 it’s really disappointing because I love the stories and the voices. I hope you change this because I can’t afford to pay just so I can sleep. I hate to have to give a bad review but I feel this is necessary.😤
Over priced. I enjoyed it and i liked the stories but after your week is up you miggr as well delete it.
What??????. What happened doze used to be free!!!

Cost money after a week. Don’t get this app, it costs a lot after a week and they basically try and trick you into getting good sleep for a couple nights so they can get u to try and buy a subscription. Snakes.

Amazing! Can’t sleep without it!. I can’t even express how much I love this app, I’m not a big fan of the stories but the voices are so calming. I love that the background noise that you choose keeps playing even after the story ends. I’m so glad I was recommended this app!
Is good thank you. ...
👌🏻👌🏻. What an amazing app 👏🏻👏🏻👏🏻👏🏻
So many awesome options!. I love how many different types of stories there are. Particularly fond of the dreamy myths. John’s voice is incredible on those!

LYING SOB'S NOT FREE SUBSCRIBTION BASED $$$. Shows / states 57 Reviews. I know I'm not a mathematician but there are only "9 reviews" just a small difference of 48 missing reviews, right? The owner(s) / developer(s) have something in common with 🤥in the White House. The media must have removed the missing reviews 😉"V O T E !"
That’s amazing!. From gavrilovmike account. thank you so much for the app, 3D sounds are extremely gorgeous!

This app is for the elite $$$. I get it everyone has to make a living.
Developers make alot of money from this hard effort. 
But it is still not affordable, abd they always reply saying there is better deals just email us....
Why not just lower the price for everyone..
What a bummer. Really liked this but all of a sudden they took away the free selections and made you pay to open app. I was unaware I was using a free trial.

No longer free. I loved the stories. I loved it was one free sleep app with stories in a mess of paid ones. Bummer. I saw the note about financial assistance, but I don’t want to have to pay for limited sound mixing with stories. Just disappointed

Subscription. What happened? This app used to be free. In the weeks that I used it, it was the only time I’d actually get a good amount of sleep. I can’t afford to pay that much for this app, and now I don’t know what I’m going to do. Could you maybe just put ads on there, or make it a one time payment? I’m sad about this, because I had so much trouble sleeping before this app and now I have to go back to that.

Audio fusion doesnt work. I only got this app because Ive been looking for ambience to play in background while listening to audiobooks and this says it does that with audiofusion. I turned it on in settings and spent 30 min listening to all the soundscapes, picked one, and it shuts off the second I play the audiobook. Tried several times. It doesnt let you mix. Very dissapointed.

Doze puts other sleep apps to bed. This app is so good it leaves me speechless. But it never leaves me sleepless. I don’t know how they do it but I swear the sleep stories make my dreams more interesting. So if you want better sleep and better dreams, download Doze tonight!
The Best Sleep App!. The selection of sounds and stories is incredible! The 3D Voice feature is AMAZING! Holy moly. So hypnotic. Can't wait to see what comes next from the developers

Very hypnotic!. The 3D voice is amazing! Excellent music and enjoyable meditation sessions, positive affirmations. I dont think it was expensive at all! 

The only thing which I would improve is that the sound and the narration, in general, could be a little louder. I already emailed them, and I thought I resolved the problem by not setting the audio fusion feature (letting the sound still go when listening to something else, such as a podcast), but I think it is still a bit quiet. However, it was designed for falling asleep, so, naturally, it shouldn’t be loud. 

Still, I think it’s a great product!
Thank you Doze!
Brilliant. You do pay money but helps even adults amazing
You DO have to pay!. It’s only the trial period that is free 🙄. Lack of clarity on app site = wasted time. Annoying
pay to use. You have to pay to use it now, either weekly, monthly or yearly. dead app
You don’t have to pay. When I first got this app I thought it was going to be one that you have to pay for but you don’t and everything is good quality, good stories and soothing, relaxing voices.
Fake. When I first downloaded this app there were lots of free options and I loved it but less than a week later it’s not letting me do anything without making me pay money. What a trick.
